noise.note: rms of each fit's own residuals on these same lines, in channels: the unit the pair and span misses are divided by, never a weight

held_out.note: each fit's mean error on the held-out line, read as printed and divided by the same group's in-sample rms; diagnostic only, and never recomputed from the lines

share_null.name: largest of n exchangeable shares
share_null.note: the fold shares are uniform on the simplex, so the total is held fixed and no fold is favoured; the null is on the share alone, says nothing about which fit is right, and enters no selection count

folds.note: per-fold errors read from results/expanded_phi_groups.json and set beside the mean printed in results/comb_vs_scale.csv; the worst fold is reported as its share of the group total, with that share's own null, and nothing enters the model-selection counts

line_fit.note: measured f_high/f_low at every adjacent pair and across each span, scored against both fits; descriptive only, since q and the step were fitted on these same lines and no null is attached

share_null.name: largest of n exchangeable shares

fold_spread.note: each fold's error read from results/expanded_phi_groups.json and set beside the mean printed in results/comb_vs_scale.csv, which is only checked against it and never replaced; the worst fold is quoted as its share of the group total and carries the exchangeable-share null, and nothing here enters the AIC, BIC or verdict counts or the campaign's own nulls

held_out.note: each group's held-out mean error set beside the rms that group was judged by; the held-out columns are read as printed and never recomputed, and nothing here replaces them or enters the AIC, BIC or verdict counts or the campaign's own nulls

noise_scale.note: the pair and span misses divided by each fit's own rms residual in channels, one rms per group estimated from the same lines, so no chi-square or null is formed and none of it enters the model-selection counts
